_comment: Single source for every threshold web-perf-ops rates against. SKILL.md's threshold table must match these numbers (check-web-perf-facts.py --offline) and triage-vitals.py reads them directly. good = 'good if <= this'; poor = 'poor if > this'; between is needs-improvement. Times in ms; CLS unitless. Assessed at the 75th percentile of page loads; mobile and desktop are assessed separately but share the same thresholds.

TBT.source: Lighthouse mobile scoring control points (p10 / median); lab-only proxy for INP

lhci.name: @lhci/cli
lhci._why: LHCI 0.15 pins lighthouse 12.6.1, so CI runs Lighthouse 12 audit ids (legacy + insight coexist), not 13's. If LHCI moves to 13, budgets-ci.md's audit-id guidance must be revisited.

partytown.name: @qwik.dev/partytown
partytown._why: @builder.io/partytown is deprecated on npm (last 0.10.3, 2024-12-20); the project moved to QwikDev and still calls itself beta.

vite.name: vite
vite._why: Build config keys move between Vite majors: Vite 8 (Rolldown) renamed build.rollupOptions to rolldownOptions and replaced output.manualChunks with output.codeSplitting. A new major means re-checking javascript.md's build-tool table against the migration guide.
